summary.text: Taner Demirci Lopez is the Libertarian Party candidate for Virginia's 7th District. According to his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, he is a scholar and former college professor who later worked as a cultural advisor to U.S. government agencies. He says he is running on restoring national independence, reducing federal spending and taxation, and reforming immigration policy.

paragraphs.text: Describes himself as a U.S. citizen raised in a multicultural family who studied Spanish language and literature.
Earned a master's degree in Religions and Cultures and a doctorate in Theology from the University of Murcia in Spain, leading to a career as a scholar and college professor, according to his survey.
Says he later left academia to work as a cultural advisor supporting several U.S. government agencies.
Says he joined the Libertarian Party because he believes the two-party system has failed to represent Americans.
